mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id FROM task WHERE record_version=3 AND media_cleanup_state='RETAINED' AND state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND updated_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 7 DAY LIMIT 32
SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state='HELD_UNKNOWN'
mapper.update: UPDATE task_image_object SET cleanup_state='DELETING' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND cleanup_state='RETAINED'
mapper.select: SELECT id,request_snapshot,request_digest FROM step WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND request_cleanup_state='RETAINED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE step SET request_snapshot=#{snapshot},request_cleanup_state='MEDIA_PURGED',retained_request_digest=#{digest} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{stepId}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,dispatch_id,category,amount,actual,usage_quality,cost_quality,state,record_version FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND category IN ('MEDIA_INPUT','MEDIA_STORAGE','MEDIA_CHECKPOINT') AND state IN ('RESERVED','SETTLED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE task_image_input SET raw_base64=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId}
UPDATE task_image_object SET cleanup_state='DELETED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND cleanup_state='DELETING'
UPDATE task SET media_cleanup_state='DELETED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}
